GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, resulting in its rdr becoming momentarily unbalanced. Rdr reported after racing wide and without cover, his mnt came under pressure from the 600m, gave no response and raced flat. Tnr stated he attributed the mare's performance to it not being suited by the soft track conditions. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Tnr subsequently reported satisfaction with the post-race condition of the mare and advised the intention is to continue with its current preparation.
